nodes.description: Private owner address of the LittleBull contract, set to msg.sender in constructor and used for all privileged checks
Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances of all holders
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) tracking spender allowances
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting the number of transfers/sales per address
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist exempting addresses from sale limits
Private uint256 maximum number of sales allowed per address
Private uint256 minimum sale value limit
Private uint256 maximum sale value limit
Address whitelisted for trading, settable by owner via setTradeAddress
Caller address supplied by the user, untrusted external input
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as source
Public payable transferFrom that manually mutates allowances, balances and _onSaleNum without SafeMath
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
Internal view whitelist/sale enforcement computing the Uniswap pair and delegating to condition
Internal view that enforces sale count and min/max sale limits using _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale
Public payable owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address
Owner-only initialization of sale limits (_minSale, _maxSale, _saleNum)
Owner-only batch transfer loop multiplying value by recipients length and updating balances
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress state variable
Internal pure function computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256 with a hardcoded init code hash
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and allowance
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address, executing external code against this contract's storage
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and unchecked balance additions/emissions in batchSend
Parameter _value amount in transfer/transferFrom used for balance and allowance math
Parameter _from source address in transferFrom/ensure
Parameter _to recipient address in transfer/transferFrom
Parameter a, the target address of the delegatecall in delegate
Parameter b, the calldata passed to delegatecall in delegate
Local variable _UNI in ensure holding the computed Uniswap pair address
Local variable total in batchSend equal to _value * _tos.length

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from source into transferFrom from transfer
msg.sender controls the allowance authorization path in transferFrom
msg.sender sets its own allowance in approve
msg.sender must equal owner to invoke delegate
msg.sender must equal owner to invoke init
msg.sender must equal owner to invoke batchSend
msg.sender must equal owner to invoke setTradeAddress
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances
ensure calls condition for sale limit checks
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce sale count
condition reads _saleNum limit
condition reads _minSale limit
condition reads _maxSale limit
ensure reads the canSale whitelist for the sender
ensure treats owner as a privileged whitelisted address
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress whitelist
ensure stores the computed pair into local _UNI
pairFor result is assigned to local _UNI in ensure
delegate executes an external delegatecall allowing arbitrary code execution and potential reentrancy against storage
parameter a is used as the delegatecall target address
parameter b is used as the delegatecall calldata
batchSend updates the balanceOf mapping
batchSend computes local total from _value and recipients length
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and additions on balances
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on balanceOf without SafeMath
init writes _minSale
init writes _maxSale
init writes _saleNum
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router address
parameter _value is consumed by transferFrom amount and allowance math
parameter _from is the source account mutated in transferFrom
parameter _to is the recipient account credited in transferFrom
parameter _to flows from transfer into transferFrom

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter only exists to feed transferFrom balance/allowance arithmetic, so it normalizes into the transferFrom function node
The _from parameter is the source account of transferFrom and has no independent semantic role beyond it
The _to parameter enters via transfer before being forwarded to transferFrom, so it folds into the transfer function node
Parameter a is solely the target address of the delegatecall unsafe operation and collapses into it
Parameter b is solely the calldata payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation and collapses into it
Local _UNI is a temporary computed inside ensure and normalizes into the ensure function node
Local total is a temporary computed inside batchSend and normalizes into the batchSend function node
